mapper.select: SELECT ur.*, u.username AS reported_username FROM user_report ur LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ur.reported_user_id = u.id WHERE ur.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_report(reported_user_id, user_id, reason, status, review_reply, cancelled, reported_username, created_at, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{reportedUserId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{reviewReply}, #{cancelled}, #{reportedUsername}, NOW(), #{reviewedAt})
